incident.summary: Approved report on a confined reality-distortion event that isolated Westview. Residents remained inside a changing artificial environment while observers recorded a stable outer boundary.
observations: Ordinary communications did not cross the recorded perimeter.
Conditions inside the boundary changed in stages.
External checks found no conventional explosive or chemical source.
incident.conclusion: The anomaly is closed as a secret case. Further public detail would expose the methods used to detect a similar boundary.
